districts.name: Baksa
districts.about: Half-wild hill district of the Bhutan foothills, where Manas shelters tiger, elephant and golden langur beside Bodo villages and threshing-floor Bihu.
districts.alt: Bhutan foothills seen from Manas National Park, Baksa

districts.name: Bajali
districts.about: Assam's smallest district — a fertile plain of satras, naamghars and the Vaishnavite scholarship of Bhattadev around Pathsala.

districts.name: Barpeta
districts.about: Born of Srimanta Sankardev's Kamala Kshetra — home of the Barpeta Satra, Puthi manuscripts and the ecstatic Fakir Borgeet tradition.

districts.name: Bongaigaon
districts.about: Gateway of lower Assam where ancient Jogighopa and the rocky Bhumeshwar hill look over the Brahmaputra's sandy beaches.

districts.name: Chirang
districts.about: BTC district of the old Bijni kingdom — Bodo plains, forested ridges and the Kamakhyaguri foothills of the Bhutan border.

districts.name: Dhubri
districts.about: One of the oldest towns of the Northeast on the Brahmaputra — busy ferry ghat, the Sri Sri Gurdwara and the temple of Dhubri Devi.
districts.alt: Scenes of Dhubri town on the Brahmaputra

districts.name: Goalpara
districts.about: Land of Surya Pahar — a hill strewn with rock-cut sun, Buddha and Hindu relics, watched over by the mighty Brahmaputra.
districts.alt: Sri Surya Mandir at Surya Pahar, Goalpara

districts.name: Kamrup
districts.about: Rural heart of ancient Kamrupa — holy Hajo, where faiths meet on Hayagriva Madhava's hill, and Sualkuchi, the muga-silk village on the Brahmaputra.
districts.alt: Hayagriva Madhava Temple at Hajo, Kamrup

districts.name: Kamrup Metropolitan
districts.about: Guwahati and Nilachal — gateway of the Northeast, cradling the Kamakhya shakti pitha and Umananda's river-island shrine.
districts.alt: Kamakhya Temple on Nilachal Hill, Guwahati

districts.name: Kokrajhar
districts.about: Capital of the Bodoland Territorial Region, guarding Raimona's rainforest and the Manas fringe with Gwcwra Bodo hospitality.
districts.alt: Stream inside Raimona National Park, Kokrajhar

districts.name: Nalbari
districts.about: Quiet Vaishnavite district of ghoshas' naamghars, the hillock Daul Mandir and mango gardens along the Burhanguri river.

districts.name: South Salmara-Mankachar
districts.about: Assam's westernmost riverine district of chars and ghatas bordering Bangladesh — home of Mankachar's Kamakhya shrine on the river bank.
districts.alt: Kamakhya Temple at Mankachar, South Salmara-Mankachar

districts.name: Tamulpur
districts.about: Newest Lower Assam district (2021) in the Bhutan foothills — Bodo villages, paddy fields and forested ridges toward Rangia.

districts.name: Biswanath
districts.about: The 'second temple city' of Assam — riverside Biswanath's Shiva ghat, cashew groves and tea estates reaching toward Kaziranga's northern range.
districts.alt: Biswanath Temple at the ghat, Biswanath

districts.name: Darrang
districts.about: Agricultural heartland of North Assam honouring the Patharighat martyrs, with paddy and mustard horizons under wide skies.

districts.name: Sonitpur
districts.about: City of eternal romance — Tezpur's Mahabhairav hill, Nameri's hornbill forests and the Bhairabkunda gorge on the Bhutan border.
districts.alt: Landscape of Nameri National Park, Sonitpur

districts.name: Udalguri
districts.about: Tea country of the Bodoland hills where Bhairabkunda's falls thunder near the Bhutan border and Bodo Bihu drums roll at dusk.

districts.name: Charaideo
districts.about: The necropolis of the Ahom kings — earth-mounded maidams compared to pyramids, inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage list in 2024.

districts.name: Dhemaji
districts.about: Land of sattras and Raas leela at the Brahmaputra's northern edge — bamboo-and-thatch naamghars, Monati fair and paddy seas.

districts.name: Dibrugarh
districts.about: Assam's tea capital on the north bank — the Bogibeel rail-road bridge, thika tea estates and the sunrise over the Brahmaputra.
districts.alt: Bogibeel bridge over the Brahmaputra, Dibrugarh

districts.name: Golaghat
districts.about: Home of Kaziranga's Kohora gate, colonial tea bungalows and the green bowl of the Dhansiri valley.

districts.name: Jorhat
districts.about: Tea capital of the world — Tocklai research institute, the last Ahom capital Thowra and the boat jetty to Majuli's sattras.

districts.name: Lakhimpur
districts.about: Land of Lachit Borphukan's tomb, the royal Dighalupukhuri pond and the Subansiri plains stretching to the Arunachal hills.

districts.name: Majuli
districts.about: The cultural capital of Assam — neo-Vaishnavite sattras, mask-making monasteries, Mishing stilt houses and red-river island life.

districts.name: Sivasagar
districts.about: Seat of the Ahom dynasty for six centuries — Rang Ghar, Talatal Ghar, Joysagar tank and the tallest Shiva Dol of Assam.

districts.name: Tinsukia
districts.about: Where India's first oil refinery fired at Digboi — the state's eastern edge with Dibru-Saikhowa's feral horses and the Brahmaputra's last bend.

districts.name: Dima Hasao
districts.about: The hill district of Assam — Haflong lake, the mystery of Jatinga's birds and a hill railway threading the Barail ranges.

districts.name: Hojai
districts.about: India's agarwood capital around Jugijan — oudh distilleries, dairy country and machang-crowned hills of the Karbi fringe.

districts.name: Morigaon
districts.about: Pobitora's rhino-rich wetlands on the Mayang fringe, with Devi Parbat's cliffs and the paper town of Jagiroad.

districts.name: Nagaon
districts.about: The cradle of Vaishnavism — Batadrava where Srimanta Sankardev was born, Assam's paddy bowl and Kaziranga's eastern gate.

districts.name: Karbi Anglong
districts.about: Highland of the Karbi people — Langkovku waterfalls, Diphu's pine hills and the Rongker festival of the Rongmei clans.

districts.name: West Karbi Anglong
districts.about: The newest hill district (2016) — misty Baithalangso, Garo-Karbi border forests and Hamren's ridges above the Vangkok river.
districts.alt: View of Baithalangso hills, West Karbi Anglong

districts.name: Cachar
districts.about: The southern valley of tea, orange and the Barak river — ancient Khaspur's Khasi kings and Silchar's cultured riverfront.
districts.alt: Ruins of the Kachari kingdom at Khaspur, Cachar

districts.name: Hailakandi
districts.about: Barak valley's garden district — orange orchards, pineapple gardens and the quiet Satras along the Barak's southern bank.

districts.name: Sribhumi
districts.about: Karimganj reborn as Sribhumi in 2024 — the 17th-century Badarpur fort, Barak canals and the eastern gate of the Barak valley.
